d:
long, straight platinum white hair with a neat center part. wide, vacant eyes of pale grey. youthful and doll-like face, appearing in the late teens. slender, delicate build. high-collared, sleeveless white dress with a flared skirt and a short black bolero jacket. features a black blindfold covering the upper half of the face and a small black visor.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
